acceptanceCriteria: Creative planning changes narrative structure, composition, motion and art direction according to content rather than selecting a fixed skin
Text, PDF, PPTX, DOCX, web, image, audio and video inputs have usable ingestion paths
Images and videos can be uploaded, semantically analyzed, assigned and rendered with correct media components
The local voice command creates the exact audio artifact consumed by the renderer
Audio, subtitles and scene timing remain aligned after synthesis and revision
No reusable component contains airplane, banking or other topic-specific visual claims
Studio supports preview, asset upload, scene revision, render/export and download from the browser workflow
Preflight blocks missing or stale voice, missing assets, unsupported media, unverified claims and semantic mismatches
The system creates render manifests, provenance, QA evidence and deterministic outputs
Commercial visual and sound quality is not claimed before actual normal-speed human review
brief.audience: A commercial creator expecting distinctive art direction and an end-to-end local production workflow.
constraints: Do not render or synthesize media until the user explicitly authorizes a generation test
User assets require rights records and semantic matching
Reusable components must not contain topic-specific claims
A newly activated project must never inherit stale audio or media from another project
brief.goal: Verify that JOEE Motion can produce genuinely content-specific, asset-aware, revisable Chinese motion videos instead of generic template swaps.
